residuals: A string of the login's files is found by its whole text. One that the screen wraps, that a tool truncates or that an encoding changes is not found by value, and the agent's own record of the conversation is the backstop.
A request the agent makes before the part stops it, such as a subagent's or a goal's first, has gone out when the part stops. The close charges it.
The proxy counts tunnels, not requests, and sees no TLS server name. The agent's own record counts the requests.
The person's own older data in the agent's history and log directories is searched whole, so a login string in it would stop a part and cannot be told from the run's.
The agent's oauth directory is not searched, because it holds the agent's own credentials.

A request for a conversation's title is seen in the conversation's own record when it succeeds and in the conversation's own log when it fails, and that log writes the line at debug level, which a run does not enable: a failed request leaves no line at the level a run uses. The pinned terminal makes no such request, and a part that sees one stops and charges it as a turn.

A launch that resumes a saved conversation runs none of the checks before its first turn, so that no shell line enters the conversation. The checks of the part's first launch, which ran the same profile, cover it.
